use: fictional portfolio concepts and brand illustration

assets.name: naya
assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create a landscape 3:2 art-directed agency portfolio photograph of a FICTIONAL beauty brand NAYA. Big bold custom modern white sans letters NAYA on a glossy pale lavender skincare tube and a bright cobalt blue cylindrical jar. A wavy lavender sculptural platform and clean lavender backdrop, direct side light, carefully styled real cosmetic product photograph. A little liquid gloss and translucent acrylic. Playful bold contemporary design, not muted luxury stock, rich lilac, cobalt, lavender, small acid-yellow label detail. Front camera angle, products big and centered, crops usable portrait or landscape. Exact text NAYA only, other label detail minimal. No real brand, no website UI, no watermark, no collage.
